main.description: Execute a read-only openCypher query against the caller's tenant graph. Translated to SQL/PGQ by kagami-cypher-compiler in the bpmn-dispatcher LangServer pool, then executed on RisingWave. WRITE clauses (CREATE / MERGE / SET / DELETE) are rejected at the edge in Phase P4a; lifted in Phase 7. ADR-2605080000 D13.

parametersJson.description: JSON-encoded parameter map; nested JSON keeps Lexicon validator happy (no array-of-object inline).

format.description: Result data contents shape, Neo4j HTTP API parity.

rowsJson.description: JSON-encoded rows array; each row is an array aligned with columns.

translatedSql.description: The SQL/PGQ that was executed (for debugging).
